question: Simplify: sec²beta-(1)/(cosec²beta-1)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put β = 45° in the given expression:

⇒ sec²(45°) − 1 / (cosec²(45°) − 1)

⇒ (√2)² − 1 / ((√2)² − 1)

⇒ 2 − 1 / (2 − 1)

⇒ 2 − 1 / 1 = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sec²β − 1 / (cosec²β − 1)

**Formula Used:**

cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1 ⇒ cosec²θ − 1 = cot²θ

1 / cotθ = tanθ

sec²θ − tan²θ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ sec²β − 1 / (cosec²β − 1)

⇒ sec²β − 1 / (cot²β)

⇒ sec²β − tan²β

⇒ 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Trigonometric Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

Reciprocal Relations

sinθ = 1 / cosecθ | cosθ = 1 / secθ | tanθ = 1 / cotθ

Quotient Relations

tanθ = sinθ / cosθ | cotθ = cosθ / sinθ
